repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Open point settled, and two added rules · 2026-11-18T15:08Z (relayed from the cloud priorities discussion, the maintainer's words verbatim)

**Cloud aligns.** At 2026-11-18T15:07Z the maintainer answered 「同意」 to the cloud plan. Cloud follows this epic's order and rules. It gets its own nine area labels (control, environment, marketplace, ai, enterprise, security, ops, fleet, ux) and its own core feature table in the cloud repo. The cloud half of the pm-dispatch change folds into child 2 (#35207). Cloud seat 1 sends the `lanes/cloud.md` text and the shared-file edits.

**Rule (a), UX grading.** The maintainer said 「4792 是每个人都用到的用户体验卡，你为什么会认为降级」 at 2026-11-18T15:02Z and 「体验相关的优先级也要提升」 at 2026-11-18T15:05Z.
- A UX problem on a shipped core path that every user hits every time is graded through the Bug table's UX row, and can be p1.
- A UX Feature defaults to p2, not p3.
- Raising an in-flight card's grade is allowed. Lowering one still is not.

**Rule (b), repo before area** (2026-11-18T14:56Z): a platform root cause is fixed in objectstack. Judge the repository first, then the area.

Both rules go into children 1 and 2. The regrade list (child 5) is re-read against rule (a) before it runs: no UX card drops to p3 on the old reading.

The other open point, who sets area, type and grade on a new card, is still open.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Ruled · 2026-11-18T15:09Z: at 2026-11-18T15:07Z the maintainer chose 「和 cloud 对齐(推荐)」 on the decision card 「objectstack 的体验卡也按 cloud 的新规则上调吗?」. This makes rule (a) in 6982539552 exact for objectstack:

1. A UX problem on a core feature that every user hits every time is p1.
2. Every other UX problem is p2. UX has no p3.
3. A Feature that improves UX defaults to p2. Other Features still never enter p1, unless one blocks another repo's p1.

The regrade list is now v3 (/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/regrade-2026-11-18.md). It gains a "UX raises" section: #35166 goes p2 → p1, 22 cards go p3 → p2, and #35141, #34889 and #34741 come off the lowering list and stay p2. The lowering list is now 16 cards. Children 1 and 2 write this rule into the grading table and the extra rules.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Ruled · 2026-11-18T15:13Z: the last open point, who labels a new card. At 2026-11-18T15:12Z the maintainer said 「新卡的问题你综合分析，我同意」 to this proposal from the discussion thread:

1. A card filed by an agent (a seat, a dev, the checklist, triage) carries its area, issue type and grade at filing. Its body carries the grade line `area · type · severity · reach · evidence`. The filing gate refuses a card missing any of them.
2. A card filed by the maintainer or by an outside person is completed at triage's first touch. A grade the maintainer set himself is never changed: triage adds only the area and the type.
3. Triage's first touch reviews every new card. When the area or the grade is wrong, triage fixes it and leaves one line with the reason and the old value.
4. A security problem is opened only as a private advisory and carries no area. This is unchanged.
5. Backstop: triage sweeps once a day for public cards with no `area:*` and completes them.

Child 2 (#35207) writes this into filing-gate and triage. No open points remain on this epic.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Confirmed (seat, on the escalation in the contract review of #35214) · 2026-11-18T15:15Z: **a card in flight may be raised, never lowered.** The permission stands.

Source chain:
1. The cloud plan's UX section says 「正在做的卡也可以升级，因为升级不会打断手上的工作」. The maintainer answered it 「同意」 at 2026-11-18T15:07Z.
2. The maintainer then chose 「和 cloud 对齐(推荐)」 for objectstack (6982581146), at the same minute.

Rule 3 of the order file, "in-flight cards are not regraded", now means they are not lowered. Lowering an in-flight card stays forbidden.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Added to child 2 (#35207) · 2026-11-18T15:20Z: the maintainer reported at 2026-11-18T15:18Z: 「我以前遇到一个问题，我看到一个issue，我在GitHub改了优先级，然后被分诊改回去了」.

Cause, as read on main by the discussion thread:
- First touch counts a card that got `priority:*` within its filing minute as untriaged "not by actor" (`references/triage-duties.md`:19, disjunct ⑤).
- No rule protects a grade the maintainer set by hand on an existing card.

Proposed rule. It is written into #35207, and the maintainer reviews it when he merges that PR:
1. A grade the maintainer set by hand is final. Before changing `priority:*`, triage and the seats read the card's latest grade-change event, and leave the grade alone when the maintainer set it.
2. To disagree, leave one line with the reason on the card and ask him through `pm:awaiting-maintainer`. The label stays as it is.
3. Disjunct ⑤ still first-touches, but it adds only the area and the type.
4. Telling a person from an agent by the label event is measured on one card in the PR first, for example the relay bot as actor or `performed_via_github_app`. If no field tells them apart, the maintainer hears that.
5. `label-write.mjs` refuses to change a grade the maintainer set by hand unless the comment cites his words in a `Ruling-ref:` line. If that is too large for the PR, it becomes a named follow-up.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Added · 2026-11-18T15:22Z, from the maintainer's words:

**2026-11-18T15:19Z** 「基于新的规范，分诊现有的 skills 是不是也要改。座位帖上有时候临时交代的事情，变成了他的长期skills，这个也有问题」
- (A) The triage skill text changes with the new rules. It folds into child 2 (#35207): `references/triage-duties.md`, `lanes/triage.md` and `references/filing-gate.md`, wherever they contradict 6982539552, 6982581146, 6982676622 and 6982729847.
- (B) A new rule goes in #35207: current values never go into a skill. The maintainer's words come in three kinds:
  - A current value (freeze, pause, focus, "p1 only", concurrency) lives only in seat posts and project memory.
  - A one-card ruling lives only on that card.
  - A standing rule is the only kind that goes into a skill.

  A standing rule needs his explicit long-term wording, or his merge of the rule PR. The skill PR body quotes each source. L1 and L2 send back any citation that reads as temporary ("先", "暂时", "这次", "现在") or that was said to one seat only.
- Child 9 (#35215): after #35207 merges, sweep pm-dispatch for entries that are current values or one-off instructions, and list them for the maintainer to delete or keep.

**2026-11-18T15:20Z** 「只要不是车队改的，就是人类改的」. This settles item 4 of 6982855148, inverted to an allow-list:
- A grade change counts as the fleet's only when the label event carries `performed_via_github_app` or a fleet bot actor (such as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`). Every other change is a person's, and its grade stays.
- #35207 measures every fleet path that writes labels (MCP, `label-write.mjs`, each workflow) and confirms that each lands inside the allow-list.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Ruled · 2026-11-18T15:26Z: at 2026-11-18T15:26Z the maintainer chose 「A 继续执行 #35205」 on the seat's decision card 「「只负责 35159」：大专题落地 #35205 还由我执行吗？」. Objectstack seat 1 keeps executing this epic. Its dev intake is #35159 only (15:24Z 「你只负责 35159」), and this epic takes no dev slot.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Route change · 2026-11-18T15:28Z: at 2026-11-18T15:27Z the maintainer asked 「35205 是一张专题卡，下面的任务是不是可以一次性pr集中处理完」.
- **One PR.** Children 1 (#35206) and 2 (#35207) ship as a single rule PR that the maintainer reviews and merges once. It is built on #35207's branch with #35214's commits merged in, and it carries `Fixes #35206` and `Fixes #35207`. #35214 closes as superseded when that PR opens.
- **No PR for the card work.** Children 3–6 and 8 (labels, backfill, regrade, `pm:epic` clean-up, closing sweep) are card writes on GitHub. They run in one pass after the merge.
- **Later PRs.** Child 7 (#35212, checklist items) and child 9 (#35215, the sweep for current-value entries) each need their own content after the rules land, so they follow as later PRs.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Order change · 2026-11-18T15:58Z: at 2026-11-18T15:56Z the maintainer asked 「domain 和优先级 不是已经定了吗？为什么现在不能改卡」. So the card work starts now and does not wait for the rule PR.

**Now:**
- Backfill `area:*` per the v2 list, in groups of ten. This started at 15:5xZ.
- Regrade per the v3 list. An in-flight card is only ever raised. Each grade line opens with a `Ruling-ref:` line citing 14:43Z 「立一张专题卡，开始执行」 and 15:56Z, so the current filing-gate rule ("a maintainer-ruled grade stays") protects it before the new rules merge.
- `pm:epic` clean-up.

**After the rule PR merges:**
- Renaming or retiring the old area labels and the old `bug` type label. `check-half-states.mjs` and `ensure-pm-labels.sh` still read them.
- Label colours and descriptions. A label created by its first use is grey with no description, and `ensure-pm-labels.sh --reconcile` sets them once the script carries the new set.

**Issue types:** they can't be set yet. The fleet's relay `issue_patch` carries no `type` field, and the organization issue-types API answers 403 to this integration. The rule PR adds `type` to the relay op. Types are applied after it merges. If that also fails, the maintainer hears that.

The closing sweep stays last.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Ruled: the maintainer's words after 15:58Z that PR #35223 encodes, recorded verbatim here (contract review E1, 6988022052). All times are 2026-11-18 UTC.

- 16:16Z 「历史卡先回填，这个字段可以空着」: historical cards get area and grade only, and the issue type stays empty. Types are set on new cards only, through the relay.
- 16:19Z 「同意」: the fleet skills review and its order of improvements. That order is children #35229–#35238.
- 16:19Z 「cloud 是不是应该放回cloud仓库」 and 16:20Z 「包括 hotcrm 每个仓库的规则都在自己仓库」: each repository's own rules live in that repository, and pm-dispatch keeps the shared mechanisms plus a pointer.
- 16:28Z 「area:cloud 就是和 cloud 仓库相关的不简单吗」, 16:29Z 「area:cloud 不要暂停」 and 「ok」: area:cloud is any card related to the cloud repository. It is not paused, a card has one area, and there is no extra access label.
- 16:48Z 「p1 是一件事，开发把小事放大是一件事」, 16:56Z 「30 天没挑就关，不需要，我会要求哪些关」, 16:57Z 「p1 的定级不是大问题，大问题是小开发放大」, 16:58Z 「同意」: package B (stop small work growing) and package A (two p1 lines). #34906 moved to p2.
- 17:40Z 「同意」: the label retirement assessment.
- 17:44Z, on a decision card, 「按来源分：车队自提 p3」: a UX-improving Feature from the maintainer or a topic defaults to p2. A fleet-sourced Feature, UX included, is p3, and unless pre-authorised it goes on the weekly list, which triage owns.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Premise corrected (contract review E4 on PR #35223, 6988773607): item 2 of 6982855148 routed a disputed hand-set grade to `pm:awaiting-maintainer`. That parks the card, because it is an exclusive state that is never dispatched. That conflicts with the maintainer's 15:18Z point that a grade he set by hand is final and stays as it is. PR #35223 at f7034cff therefore writes it as one comment line, and the grade and the card's state stay unchanged. This is the seat's reading of 15:18Z. The maintainer's merge of #35223 confirms it; if he wants the parking route instead, it is a one-line change in filing-gate.
